_readme: Garments offered by the photorealistic try-on screen.
IMPORTANT: 'image' must be an ISOLATED product photo of the garment alone
- a flat lay or ghost-mannequin shot on a plain background. A photo of a
model wearing the item is NOT a garment asset: the generator would try to
transfer the model's body along with the clothing, and the result looks
wrong. The Unsplash URLs in src/data/catalog.ts are full-person reference
photography and are deliberately not listed here.
'category' selects which part of the customer is repainted:
To add a SKU: drop its isolated photo in this folder and add an entry.
